In Zephyr, driver source files are typically compiled and linked based on Kconfig options. By changing the condition in `drivers/can/CMakeLists.txt` from `CAN_FAKE` to `ZTEST`, the `can_fake.c` source file will be compiled and linked whenever `CONFIG_ZTEST` is enabled (which it is for this test), thus resolving the undefined reference errors without modifying the test's own configuration files.
